subSteps.title: 3D print all mechanical components (receiver, stock, grip, etc.)
Install M3 heat-set inserts into designated mounting points on 3D printed parts
Cut and deburr outer barrel, inner barrel, and cylinder sleeve to final dimensions
Test-fit trigger component into trigger box and piston assembly into cylinder sleeve
Solder power leads (VIN+, VIN-) from battery pack to 5V step-down converter
Solder regulated 5V output (VOUT+, VOUT-) from buck converter to main MCU's power inputs
Solder wires to the Trigger Micro Switch (COM and NO terminals)
Solder wires to the Safety Selector Switch (COM, POS1, and POS2 terminals)
Connect trigger switch and safety switch to main MCU's GPIO and 3.3V/GND pins
Perform continuity checks on all soldered connections to prevent shorts
Power on buck converter and verify 5V output using a multimeter
Connect main MCU to computer and upload initial firmware
Test trigger switch input by observing serial output on main MCU
Test safety switch input (POS1/POS2) by observing serial output on main MCU
Verify basic power delivery and data communication between all electrical components
Assemble magazine: insert magazine spring and magazine follower into magazine body
Assemble piston: attach piston head to piston body and insert main spring
Mount Trigger Micro Switch into Trigger Box Housing and install trigger component
Install Inner Barrel into Hop-Up Unit, then seat Inner Barrel concentrically within Outer Barrel with Stabilizer Ring
Mount main MCU, buck converter, and safety switch into their respective 3D printed mounts
Assemble the main receiver body with buttstock, handguard, pistol grip, trigger box, barrel assembly, and internal mechanism components
Route all electrical wiring, secure with zip ties or clips, and connect battery pack to battery tray
Perform final system test, checking trigger response, safety function, and mechanical action
